text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I rewatched my race
and realized something.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I'm not running in a straight line...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Twice in that race alone.
She is tilting roughly two degrees off-axis relative to the straightaways.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Kh, and on top of that, to think it's wrinkled, even if only slightly...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "...If not for these, I wouldn't have missed out on 1st place."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
As long as I can see the goal, all that's left is to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "You ran extra distance, so you should correct that."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: How about using surveying equipment from the construction site?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I've heard that with that,
it can measure deviations down to 0.1 degrees.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Please consider it, and I ask that you continue with thorough training starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how high it is, all you have to do is climb over it.
That is far better than giving up and taking a detour."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep charging straight ahead, now and always.
Straighter and faster in the next race...!
